question.text: The Private Placement Memorandum (PPM) of an AIF must be filed with SEBI through a ______ in the prescribed format for SEBI's observations.

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI requires the PPM of every AIF to be filed through a SEBI-registered Merchant Banker in the prescribed format. The merchant banker conducts due diligence and certifies the filing. The Trap: CA audits books; SEBI-registered IA is an individual-advisory role (X-A/X-B); trustee cannot file directly with SEBI for AIF registration — must go through merchant banker. Cross-Exam Context: Shared concept across XIX-A/B/C/D. XXI-A PMS filings do NOT require merchant banker — distinct from AIF.
